10.title: Procedural lighthouse
10.visualRubric: A strong frame shows the whole lighthouse centred, readable at thumbnail size. Score each 1-5: (1) Silhouette and proportion: tapered tower, gallery, lantern and roof read unmistakably as a lighthouse, with a cottage and rocks in believable scale. (2) Detail density: railing, windows, door, bands, finial, trim rings, rock variety are all visible rather than a stack of plain cylinders. (3) Materials and colour: banding is crisp, lamp glows, stone/roof/glass look distinct, palette is coherent. (4) Lighting and depth: shadows, shading gradients and fill give volume, sea or ground and sky give context, nothing is flat or blown out. (5) Composition and polish: framing leaves margins, no z-fighting, floating parts or clipping, horizon is level.
10.probe: Load the page, wait until window.__TASK_STATE__.ready === true (timeout 20s), read partCount and bandCount, and capture frames at t=1s and t=3s. Pass the motion check if mean per-pixel absolute difference between the two frames exceeds a small threshold (e.g. 0.5% of pixels changed by more than 8/255). Also confirm the canvas #app is non-uniform (colour variance above threshold) and there are no uncaught page errors.

11.title: Procedural medieval handcart
11.visualRubric: A strong frame shows the whole cart at three-quarter angle with wheels clearly circular and spoked. Score each 1-5: (1) Structural plausibility: wheels touch the ground, axle aligns, bed sits on it, handles and prop leg make mechanical sense. (2) Craft detail: individual planks, spokes, rails, iron bands and bolts are visible; wood looks assembled not extruded. (3) Material and colour: wood tones vary, iron reads darker and metallic, sacks/barrels differ from the cart, palette is warm and cohesive. (4) Lighting and grounding: soft shadows under the cart and cargo, ground contact is believable, form is readable in shadowed areas. (5) Composition and polish: cart fills most of the frame with margins, cargo is neatly placed, no clipping, floating parts or z-fighting.
11.probe: Load the page, wait for window.__TASK_STATE__.ready === true (20s timeout), read wheelCount, spokeCount, plankCount, then capture frames at t=1s and t=3s and compute the frame difference; pass if more than 0.5% of pixels change by over 8/255 between them. Confirm canvas is non-uniform and no uncaught page errors.

12.title: Procedural stylised tree (seasonal)
12.visualRubric: A strong frame shows the full tree centred with sky behind and a readable mound beneath. Score each 1-5: (1) Silhouette and organic form: trunk flare, tapering limbs and an asymmetric, believable crown rather than a lollipop of one sphere on a cylinder. (2) Detail density: multiple branching levels, varied clumps, roots, knot, swing/bird house, ground clutter all discernible. (3) Colour and material: bark and foliage are distinct, foliage has tonal variation and light/dark depth, palette is cohesive. (4) Lighting and depth: crown shadows land on the mound, light through the crown gives volume, background and ambient light avoid flatness. (5) Composition and polish: tree fits with margins, branches connect to the trunk without gaps or floating pieces, no z-fighting or clipping.
12.probe: Load the page, wait for window.__TASK_STATE__.ready === true (20s timeout), read branchCount, foliageClumpCount, seed; reload the page and confirm the seed and counts are identical (determinism). Capture frames at t=1s and t=3s and pass the motion check if over 0.5% of pixels differ by more than 8/255. Confirm the canvas is non-uniform and no uncaught page errors.
